summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust filed an 8-K disclosing completion of the sale of the Sheraton Indianapolis City Centre Hotel. Its wholly owned subsidiary sold the hotel to Keystone Realty Group LLC for a gross purchase price of $32.1 million in cash, subject to $15.2 million in buyer credits and customary adjustments, yielding net proceeds of ~$16.5 million. The seller also paid ~$14.6 million to the mortgage lender whose loan was secured by a nine-hotel pool including this asset. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The transaction closed on May 21, 2026. Watch for the impact on Ashford's portfolio deleveraging and the release of collateral from the cross-collateralized mortgage pool.
